purpose: Design of the version management workflow: .version-config.yaml schema, scripts, and update-version/setup-version-config procedures for synchronizing versions across files in multi-plugin repositories.
summary: Overview and design principles: non-destructive low-level script, text-based replacement, filter narrowing
.version-config.yaml schema: targets, sync_files, changelog, git settings
Git tag search rules: four candidates by prefix and v presence, with search order
scan_version_targets.py design and version_ref_files detection algorithm
calculate_version.py: bump specs, v prefix tolerance, warning on non-increasing versions
update_version_files.py: filter, changelog_header, path, simple modes and drift/not-found error separation
get_version_status.py: base branch comparison and version extraction
setup-version-config and update-version step-by-step workflows, CHANGELOG insertion
Error handling tables, test file list, and affected files
tasks: Changing update_version_files.py or its I/O adapters
Generating CHANGELOG entries and git tags during release
Writing or reviewing tests for version scripts
title: DES-023 バージョン管理ワークフロー設計書
